review_scope: Bounded static source/patch/fixture review plus first completed restore-only diagnostic; no VM run by reviewer.

event_context_patch.format: cpu/chaomofa-tcg-event-context-v1, version1/minimum1, always sent for TCG; INT32 error_code, INT32 exception_is_int, target_ulong exception_next_eip, INT32 old_exception.
event_context_patch.basis: Existing main CPU version/fields and cpu/error_code subsection unchanged. Extra subsection is same-build only; old readers reject unknown section and old streams lack these values.
event_context_patch.inactive_values: Preserve exact raw fields even if not currently meaningful. No load-time clear or comparator filtering. Existing error_code subsection, if also emitted, carries the same source value.
event_context_patch.validity: exception_index<0 bypasses synchronous exception handling. Internal exit indices >=EXCP_INTERRUPT(0x10000) take the loop-exit path and are reset to -1. Guest exception indices dispatch through x86_cpu_do_interrupt, except EXCP_VMEXIT(0x100) has a separate VM-exit path. exception_next_eip is relevant to INT-instruction delivery when exception_is_int is true. old_exception tracks in-flight nested-fault classification and becomes -1 after successful delivery.
event_context_patch.diagnostic_interpretation: First source A has exception_index=-1/old_exception=-1 but exception_is_int=1,next_eip=0x168. Those are retained earlier INT payload, not proof of a pending INT. Target resetting them was nonetheless a raw-state equality failure, now addressed by serialization.
event_context_patch.remaining_scope: Preserving four fields is not exhaustive CPU event-state capture. CPU common already stores exception_index/interrupt_request/halted; hflags2 is in main x86 VMState. Device interrupt controller/timer state and other queued events remain separate.

rf_observer_patch.source_mechanism: RF suppresses BP_CPU in x86_debug_check_breakpoint. BP_GDB may still cause EXCP_DEBUG, and the old breakpoint_handler then tested BP_CPU at that address without rechecking RF, calling raise_exception(#DB). Thus an observer at a DR execution-breakpoint address could introduce an extra guest exception despite RF=1.
rf_observer_patch.change: Only non-watchpoint branch now requires !(env->eflags & RF_MASK) before reclassifying observer exit as architectural instruction #DB. Does not change guest instruction bytes, RF, DRs, watchpoints or RF=0 event behavior.
rf_observer_patch.must_test: Owned guest with active DR0/DR7 must first take its ordinary RF=0 #DB, have its IDT handler set RF in the saved frame, return by IRETD to the overlapping GDB stop, expose RF=1/handler_count=1, then resume/consume once without a second #DB. Raw trace, saved exception frame and final counters must agree.
rf_observer_patch.not_claimed: At report creation this reviewer has only statically validated the v8 change; no assertion of a completed native RF case or general observer transparency.

runstate_patch.change: Adds INMIGRATE -> DEBUG to legal transitions. No automatic cont or forced guest run.
runstate_patch.reason: process_incoming_migration_bh loads a saved nonlive runstate by runstate_set(global_state_get_runstate()). Source at a debugger stop saves DEBUG. This requires the missing transition.
runstate_patch.actual_diagnostic: Source v6 to target v6b restore-only reused the original stream, exited33 with matching CPU/RAM/output but retained raw-event differences. Different builds mean diagnostic only, not same-build acceptance.

observer_review.ram: Enumerates RAMBlock host mappings under RCU and hashes used_length with SHA256; current 64-bit build supports each full4GiB size. Fixed machine observed eight blocks totaling4,312,342,528 bytes including VGA and ROM blocks. This measures RAMBlock payloads, not the complete MMIO address-space topology or external resources.
observer_review.stopping: Requires nonrunning TCG and every CPUState.stopped. RCU protects RAMBlock lifetime, not contents; VP stop alone is not a universal DMA/IOthread quiescence guarantee. Current diskless/no-network/no-passthrough fixture is the bounded scope.
observer_review.strings: Current observed IDs contain no JSON control characters; source rejects quote/backslash/LF/CR, not every possible control byte. Generic arbitrary machine IDs are not qualified.
observer_review.events: Raw selected CPU fields retained, no lossy pending/inactive normalization. HARD=2 is a real independent interrupt request and cannot be removed as an inactive synchronous payload.
observer_review.clock: Default RTC clock is HOST, whereas icount controls VIRTUAL. Explicit identical -icount shift=0,align=off,sleep=off and -rtc clock=vm,base=fixed in both processes avoids that known host-time source; actual event equality still required.

static_findings: Master/slave PIC vectors20h/28h, onlyIRQ0 unmasked. PIT channel0 command30h/count16 programs one-shot mode0.
IF remains clear from entry; OCW3 IRR polling JZ f6 returns exactly to the10-byte polling sequence. A at1002f0 precedes STI/NOP; relativeJMP09 goes to100300.
IRQ32 gate points to100500. Handler PUSHAD, increments102004, emitsQ, sends master EOI, POPAD/IRETD. #DB remains separate vector1 path.

Require real HARD request at A, IF0, exactly one delivered INT20 and IRQ count1 after resume; source/target complete events, allRAM and architectural57 still must match. This asynchronous IRQ is not a queued synchronous exception payload test.

anchors: 135-142 architectural instruction BP disabled by RF
146-169 HOST default versus explicit VIRTUAL clock

admission_limit: Canonical57 remains ordinary protected32 only. WOW64 compatibility mode and full64 envelope are refused by the current adapter. No Windows/game/resource-lifetime acceptance follows from these source fixes or microguests.
